statement: Each account is displayed field by field on SYSOUT.
OUTFILE carries the account with CURR-CYC-DEBIT packed (COMP-3); 2525.00 is moved only when the debit is zero.
The reissue date is reformatted by the assembler routine COBDATFT (type 2 in, type 2 out: YYYY-MM-DD -> YYYYMMDD).
ARRYFILE: occurrence 1 and 2 copy the balance with debits 1005.00 / 1525.00; occurrence 3 is -1025.00 / -2500.00.
VBRCFILE receives a 12-byte and a 39-byte variable record per account.
Every card record is read sequentially by card number and displayed on SYSOUT.
Interest is computed per TCATBALF record as (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 with no ROUNDED phrase: the result is truncated to 2 decimals.
Interest is only computed when the disclosure-group rate is non-zero.
When the account's disclosure group is missing (status 23) the DEFAULT group is read.
The accumulated interest is added to ACCT-CURR-BAL when the account changes.
Cycle credit and cycle debit are reset to zero on account update.
The account update is triggered only by an account break (first record suppressed); the last account at end-of-file is never updated (legacy quirk).
Interest transaction id = PARM date (10) + 6-digit running suffix.
Interest transactions carry type 01, category 05, source 'System'.
Description is 'Int. for a/c ' followed by the account id.
Origin and processing timestamps are the DB2-format current timestamp (frozen clock in the harness).
The card number on the interest transaction comes from the XREF alternate index keyed by account id.
1400-COMPUTE-FEES is a placeholder with no logic (fees not implemented).
A daily transaction whose card number is not in XREF is rejected with reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'.
A transaction whose account is missing is rejected with reason 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.
Credit limit check uses cycle amounts: limit >= cycle credit - cycle debit + amount, else reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.
Expiry check: account expiration date >= origin date (first 10 chars), else reason 103; 103 overwrites 102 when both fail.
Rejected transactions are written to DALYREJS as the 350-byte record plus an 80-byte trailer (reason 9(4) + description X(76)).
Missing (account, type, category) balance records are created with the transaction amount.
Existing category balances are incremented by the transaction amount.
The amount is added to ACCT-CURR-BAL; non-negative amounts to cycle credit, negative amounts to cycle debit.
Posted transactions get PROC-TS = current DB2-format timestamp.
TRANSACT is opened OUTPUT: the posted-transaction file is replaced by this run's postings.
Return code 4 when at least one transaction was rejected.
Report period is read from DATEPARM (start date, filler, end date).
A transaction outside the period triggers NEXT SENTENCE, which leaves the whole PERFORM loop (no totals written) - legacy quirk.
A change of card number writes the account total of the previous card (not before the first).
Every line counter multiple of the page size (20) writes page totals and new headers.
Page totals roll into the grand total and reset; account totals reset but do not reset the page total.
At end-of-file the last TRAN-AMT is added again to page and account totals before page and grand totals are written; the final account total is never written - legacy quirk.
XREF, TRANTYPE and TRANCATG lookups that fail abend the program (U999).
The detail line carries id, account, type code/desc, category code/desc, source and the edited amount (-ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ).
OPEN FILE OK / NOT OK is displayed and the read loop runs either way (0001-OPEN-FILES falls through).
Record type A inserts, U updates, D deletes, '*' is a comment; any other type is an error.
INSERT/UPDATE bind the 2-character type code and the full 50-character description (trailing spaces stored).
SQLCODE +100 on UPDATE/DELETE would report 'No records found.', but Open COBOL ESQL returns 0 when no row matches, so a missing row reports success (fixture t05).
An error DISPLAYs WS-RETURN-MSG (never cleared), sets RETURN-CODE 4 and processing continues with the next record.
Negative SQLCODE message: 'Error accessing: TRANSACTION_TYPE table. SQLCODE:' followed by SQLCODE edited ----9.
DYNSQL lines starting with '--' are skipped; columns 1-72 of the other lines are concatenated, each followed by one blank, into an 800-byte statement.
The statement is PREPAREd and EXECUTEd; the EXECUTE SQLCODE is displayed (statement errors surface at EXECUTE under ocesql).
A failed PREPARE or EXECUTE sets RETURN-CODE 8 and processing continues.
The program named in PARMS is CALLed dynamically (CALL identifier); COBTUPDT's STOP RUN ends the run unit, so 'CBTRNDYN: END' is not reached.
